basics.title: What ANGKASA And A PBA Code Are
basics.para1: ANGKASA — Angkatan Koperasi Kebangsaan Malaysia Berhad — is the national cooperative organisation. Through its Biro Perkhidmatan Angkasa (BPA), it has run Malaysia's salary deduction system for public sector employees since 1977.
basics.para2: A <emphasis>PBA code</emphasis> is the identifier ANGKASA issues to an approved organisation. It is what allows your loan repayments, contributions or fees to be deducted directly from a member's monthly payslip and remitted to you — instead of you chasing payment each month.

process.title: We Run The Whole Application
process.subtitle: Most organisations stall on the same things: an entity that is not structured the way ANGKASA expects, incomplete documents, and no one to follow up. We handle all of it.

assess.title: Eligibility assessment
assess.description: We review your entity, licence status, financials and product against what ANGKASA looks for, and tell you plainly whether to proceed.

entity.title: Entity setup and restructuring
entity.description: If the structure does not qualify yet, we fix it — incorporation, cooperative registration, director and shareholder changes, and the SSM or CoSec work behind them.

submit.title: Application prepared and submitted
submit.description: We assemble the full document set, write the supporting submissions, and file the application so it is right the first time.

liaison.title: Liaison until approval
liaison.description: We deal with ANGKASA and BPA on your behalf — queries, clarifications, additional documents — and keep you updated as it moves.

manage.title: Ongoing code management
manage.description: Once the code is live we keep it in good standing: renewals, updates to your particulars, and the reporting that comes with it.

items.question: What is a PBA code, in one sentence?
items.answer: It is the code ANGKASA issues to an approved organisation so that money owed to you — a loan instalment, a contribution, a fee — can be deducted directly from a member's monthly salary and paid across to you.

items.question: Who can apply for one?
items.answer: Cooperatives, licensed money lenders, insurance and takaful providers, foundations, associations and other organisations that collect regular payments from public sector employees. The right route depends on your entity type and what you collect — that is the first thing we assess.

items.question: How long does approval take?
items.answer: It depends on your starting point. An entity that already qualifies moves faster than one that needs restructuring first. We give you an honest timeline at the assessment stage rather than a headline number.

items.question: What if our entity does not qualify yet?
items.answer: We fix it. Entity setup and restructuring is part of the engagement — incorporation or cooperative registration, director and shareholder changes, and bringing statutory filings up to date before we submit.

items.question: Do you stay involved after the code is issued?
items.answer: Yes. We manage the code on an ongoing basis — renewals, changes to your particulars, and coordination with ANGKASA when something needs attention. The same team that ran your application handles it.

items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Book a free consultation. We will look at your entity, licence position and what you want to collect, then tell you whether a PBA code is realistic and what it would take to get there.
